name: Systems Security Certified Practitioner

fee.note: U.S. list price for the Americas, Asia Pacific, the Middle East and Africa; EMEA pays EUR 239.04 and the UK GBP 201.69. Taxes depend on the exam location.

exam.format: Computerized adaptive test (CAT) at Pearson VUE test centers: 100–125 multiple choice and advanced items in 2 hours. Offered in English, Japanese and Spanish.

scope: Hands-on operational security: security concepts and practices, access controls, risk monitoring and analysis, incident response and recovery, cryptography, network and communications security, and systems and application security.
requirements: To be certified: one year of full-time experience in one or more of the seven SSCP domains; a relevant bachelor's or master's degree can satisfy it, and part-time work and internships count. Without it, passing makes you an Associate of ISC2 with up to two years to earn the experience. Within nine months of passing, an ISC2-certified member (or ISC2, with proof of employment) must endorse the application.
ai_policy: Check the current assessment rules. AI-assisted study does not imply permission during the exam.
caveats: The current outline took effect October 1, 2025; ISC2 has not announced a newer one.

Prices and taxes follow the exam location: ISC2 lists U.S. dollars for most regions, euros for EMEA and pounds for the UK. Pearson VUE charges U.S. $50 to reschedule and U.S. $100 to cancel. Confirm at checkout.
An exam-only purchase is one attempt that must be taken within 365 days. ISC2 also sells Peace of Mind Protection (two attempts within 180 days); its price is not on the pricing page.
Staying certified: U.S. $135 a year and 60 CPE credits per three-year cycle. Associates of ISC2 pay U.S. $50 a year and earn 15 CPE credits a year.
